description: A house 30 feet by 20 whose south corners are cut on a 3 : 4 slope, 3 feet by 4: each oblique edge is 5 feet long, an integer, so its plane has rational coefficients and the roof is derived (16.4.3). The two oblique edges rise at 9 in 12, the north at 4 in 12 and the rest at 6; the points where the oblique faces close are rational but not integers, and are rounded once.
